```{r import datasets, include=FALSE}
  table_lum_CarTrans_V2 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir, "data", "Lum_CarTrans_V2_all.xlsx"))

table_lum_CarTrans_V2 <- table_lum_CarTrans_V2 %>% select(-ATG_EMB1_3)
table_lum_CarTrans_V3 <- table_lum_CarTrans_V3 %>% select(-ATG_EMB1_3)


# Combine Tables
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- rbind(table_lum_CarTrans_V0, table_lum_CarTrans_V1, table_lum_CarTrans_V2, table_lum_CarTrans_V3, table_lum_CarTrans_V4, table_lum_CarTrans_V5, table_lum_CarTrans_VX, table_lum_healthy)  %>%
    mutate(across(-c(Study_ID, Visit, ISHLT_1990, ISHLT_2004, Class_Sup, Transplantation_risk), ~{

```

```{r clean overall table}
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  select(-ISHLT_1990, -ISHLT_2004)
```

```{r prep metadata}
# Rename visits in overall table
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(
    Visit = as.character(Visit),
    Visit = case_when(
    Visit == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",
    Visit == "V0" ~ "Baseline",
    Visit == "V1" ~ "Week 1",
    Visit == "V2" ~ "Week 2",
    Visit == "V3" ~ "Month 1-3",
    Visit == "V4" ~ "Month 4-6",
    Visit == "V5" ~ "Month 12",
    grepl("^VX", Visit) ~ Visit, #keep different X timepoints to not create duplicates
    TRUE~Visit
    ),
    Visit = factor(Visit,levels = c("Healthy","Baseline","Week 1","Week 2","Month 1-3","Month 4-6","Month 12", "VX1", "VX2", "VX3", "VX4")) 
  )

# Assign unique sample IDs for each study ID
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(Sample_ID = paste(Study_ID, Visit, sep = "_"))

# Combine X timepoints to one rejection bin
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(Timepoint= case_when(grepl("^VX", Visit) ~ "Rejection Context",TRUE ~ Visit))
```

```{r create dataframe}
df <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  filter(Timepoint != "Healthy") %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint,
                        levels = c("Baseline", "Week 1", "Week 2", "Month 1-3", "Month 4-6", "Month 12", "Rejection Context")),
    Class_Sup = factor(Class_Sup, levels = 1:6, ordered = TRUE),  # ordinal outcome
    Transplantation_risk = as.numeric(Transplantation_risk),      # continuous predictor
    Study_ID = factor(Study_ID)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Timepoint), !is.na(Class_Sup), !is.na(Transplantation_risk))
```

```{r visualize distribution for ordinal ordering, fig.height=10, fig.width=15}
# Boxplot by risk tertile
df_plot <- df %>%
  mutate(risk_tertile = ntile(Transplantation_risk, 3),
         risk_tertile = factor(risk_tertile, labels = c("Low", "Mid", "High")))
 
ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = risk_tertile, y = as.numeric(as.character(Class_Sup)),
                     fill = risk_tertile)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +          # outliers off - raw points show them
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.8, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Timepoint, nrow = 2) +
  labs(x = "Transplantation risk tertile", y = "Immunosuppression class (1-6)",
       title = "Immunosuppression severity by risk tertile and timepoint") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r visualize distribution for continous ordering, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}

ggplot(df, aes(x = Transplantation_risk, y = as.numeric(as.character(Class_Sup)))) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0.15, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "firebrick") +

       title = "Immunosuppression severity vs. transplantation risk by timepoint") +

```

```{r patient trajectories}
               group = Study_ID, color = factor(Transplantation_risk))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ann_colors$Transplantation_risk) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

## Primary model: cumulative link mixed model (ordinal outcome)
Mixed cumulative link model (clmm): random intercept at 1|Study_ID) to account for repeated measurement per patients

```{r}
## Full model with Transplantation_risk x Timepoint interaction
mod_full <- clmm(Class_Sup ~ Transplantation_risk * Timepoint + (1 | Study_ID),
                  data = df, link = "logit")
summary(mod_full)
```

```{r} 
## Reduced model without interaction: overall effect of risk score-
## assuming its effect is stable across timepoints
mod_main <- clmm(Class_Sup ~ Transplantation_risk + Timepoint + (1 | Study_ID),
                  data = df, link = "logit")

summary(mod_main)

# Random effects
## Shows between-patient variance in baseline immunosuppresion tendency: large variance = quite heterogeneous at the same risk score and timepoint (no p-value)

# Coefficients (fixed effects)
## Transplantation_risk: log odds; positive value means higher risk score is associated with higher odds of being in a higher immunosuppression class, holding timepoint constant
## Timepoint: each timepoint compared to reference level (Baseline)
## Pr(>|z|): p-value for each coefficient indiviually (Wald test)
```
```{r}
# Estimated marginal means / effect sizes at each timepoint
emmeans(mod_main, ~ Transplantation_risk | Timepoint, at = list(Transplantation_risk = c(0, 2.5, 5)))
 
```


```{r}
## Likelihood ratio test: is the interaction actually needed?
anova(mod_main, mod_full)

# Pr(>Chisq) < 0.05: risk scores effect on immunosuppression genuinely differs by timepoint
```

```{r}
## Turns mod_main Transplantation_risk coefficient into Odds ratio:
##   exp(coef) = odds ratio for being in a higher immunosuppression class
##   per 1-point increase in risk score, adjusted for timepoint.
exp(coef(mod_main)["Transplantation_risk"])
confint(mod_main)  # insert Confidence Interval
```
 
## Sensitivity check: linear mixed model (treat Class_Sup as continuous) 
Direction and significance should roughly agree between mod_main/mod_full (CLMM) and mod_lmer

```{r}
mod_lmer <- lmer(as.numeric(as.character(Class_Sup)) ~
                    Transplantation_risk * Timepoint + (1 | Study_ID), data = df)
summary(mod_lmer)

# Random effects
## Residuals: leftover within-patient variability accross timepoints/risk not explained by the fixed effects
# Fixed effects
## Transplantation_risk: direct slope (not log-odds), holding timepoint constant
## df and p-value come from the Satterhwaite approximation
```

```{r}
anova(mod_lmer)   # Type III test, Satterthwaite df

# Tests term as a whole (Timepoint across all its levels jointly)
```

## Risk score prediction on immunosuppression in rejection context
```{r}
# Mixed cumulative link model
df_rejection <- df %>% filter(Timepoint == "Rejection Context")
 
mod_rejection <- clmm(Class_Sup ~ Transplantation_risk + (1 | Study_ID), data = df_rejection)
summary(mod_rejection)
 
```
# Transplantation risk on overall analytes (z-score)

```{r compute z score}
#Define analytes
analyte_cols <- setdiff(colnames(table_lum_CarTrans_overall), c("Study_ID", "Timepoint", "Sample_ID", "ISHLT_2004", "Visit", "Transplantation_risk", "Class_Sup"))

# Log transform input values
table_lum_CarTrans_overall_z <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(analyte_cols), ~ log2(pmax(., 1))))

# Calculate healthy mean and SD as reference
healthy_ref <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall_z %>%
  filter(Visit == "Healthy") %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(analyte_cols),
                   list(mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
                        sd   = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE))))

# Calculate Z score
z_data <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall_z

for (col in analyte_cols) {
  mu <- healthy_ref[[paste0(col, "_mean")]]
  sd <- healthy_ref[[paste0(col, "_sd")]]
  
  if (is.na(sd) || sd == 0) {
    z_data[[col]] <- NA
  } else {
    z_data[[col]] <- (z_data[[col]] - mu) / sd
  }
}

# Set global score per sample
z_data <- z_data %>%mutate(global_z = rowMeans(across(all_of(analyte_cols)), na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r global Z score pooled accross timepoints}
z_data_plot <- z_data %>%
  filter(!Timepoint %in% c("Healthy", "Baseline")) %>%
  mutate(
    Transplantation_risk = factor(Transplantation_risk),
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint,
                        levels = c("Baseline", "Week 1", "Week 2",
                                   "Month 1-3", "Month 4-6", "Month 12",
                                   "Rejection Context"))
  )
 

# Visulization pooled timepoints
ggplot(z_data_plot, aes(x = Transplantation_risk, y = global_z,
                         fill = Transplantation_risk)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ann_colors$Transplantation_risk) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Global Z-score by Transplantation Risk Class",
       x = "Transplantation risk", y = "Global Z-score (vs Healthy)",
       caption = "*Global Z-score: mean Z-score across all analytes")
```
```{r global z score Trans_risk per timepoint, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
ggplot(z_data_plot, aes(x = Timepoint, y = global_z, group = Study_ID,
                         color = Transplantation_risk)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = Transplantation_risk), fun = mean, geom = "line",
               linewidth = 1.3) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = Transplantation_risk), fun = mean, geom = "point",
               size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ann_colors$Transplantation_risk) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
        plot.caption.position = "plot",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(title = "Longitudinal Immune Profiling by Transplantation Risk Class",
       y = "Global Z-score (vs Healthy)", color = "Risk score",
       caption = "*Global Z-score: mean Z-score across all analytes")
```
